data_as_of: Pre-market quotes from StockAnalysis.com quote API and Yahoo Finance v7/v1 (~7:40-7:52 a.m. CT Nov 12). Futures, VIX, 10Y, DXY, WTI, gold from Yahoo ~7:39 a.m. CT; Bitcoin ~7:49 a.m. CT. Prior closes are Wednesday Nov 11.
headline: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO (CFO Colette Kress named interim); NVDA is down ~10% pre-market and Nasdaq-100 futures are down 1.3%.
drivers: Nvidia said at 7:48 a.m. CT that Jensen Huang has resigned as president, CEO and director, effective immediately. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent CEO, and Harvey Jones becomes the company's first board chair. The news follows reports of a second affair, this time with an Nvidia executive. Bernstein and Oppenheimer both downgraded NVDA to Market Perform earlier this morning. NVDA is down ~10% pre-market and pulling the AI trade lower (CRWV −11%, NBIS −16% despite a Q3 beat, SNDK −7%, MU −5%, TSM −3%), while AMD and Broadcom are up 2-3%. Nasdaq-100 futures are down 1.3%, partly reversing Wednesday's CoreWeave-led chip rally. The 10-year yield, back from the Veterans Day break, is at ~5.05%. Markets price a Fed hike on Dec 9 after Tuesday's hot CPI, and six Fed speakers are on today's schedule. WTI is up ~1% after Trump said 'we don't need a deal with Iran'; gold is down 2.3%. Bitcoin is down 1.5%, and MSCI is removing Strategy (MSTR) from its indexes.

notes: Run started 7:48 a.m. CT; session = PRE-MARKET. All mover tables use pre-market quotes vs Wednesday's close.

The Mac browser worked: Yahoo Finance v7/v1 (screener over ~5,250 US stocks with market cap ≥ $2B) and StockAnalysis quote API (pre-market price/volume) were live with Nov 12 timestamps. CNBC (403), Benzinga and StockTitan failed via WebFetch; Benzinga and Yahoo pages were read through the Mac browser instead.
Pre-market relative volume isn't available, so relvol is null in the movers, most-active and watchlist tables. In 'unusual', relvol = pre-market volume ÷ 3-month average full-day volume.
Some sources disagree: MDU +2.8% (StockAnalysis, 437 shares) vs +10.3% (Yahoo); DPC +2.6% to +7.3% within minutes. Thin pre-market prints; treat with caution.
WTI: Yahoo CL=F shows $87.43 (+1.0%); Yahoo's live blog quoted 'WTI $94', which matches Brent (~$94). The CL=F quote is used.
Gold is the front-month COMEX future (GC=F). Bitcoin change is Yahoo's 24-hour figure.
Jobless claims (7:30 a.m. CT) came out before publishing but the figure wasn't retrieved.

Watchlist reads the catalyst list strictly: CHA (special dividend) and MSTR (MSCI index removal) were left out as outside the listed catalyst types. NVDA qualifies through its two analyst downgrades plus the CEO resignation.
Under-$5 lists: exchange-listed only, pre-market volume ≥ 100K. Float and reverse-split history weren't checked; flags are best-effort.
